metadata.title: Phase 11C — Production Candidate-Depth Diagnostic Canonical Reconciliation Dataset

control.gating_semantics: Script gated on Candidate Recall (85.0%) and Final Recall (70.0%) within ±3% tolerance, and logged all four metrics.

dense_sources.sq_text: Adriana marriage to Antipholus of Ephesus twin brother
Antipholus of Syracuse character background and relationship to Dromio
Antipholus of Syracuse character background and relationship to Dromio

rank_semantics.audit_finding: The candidate_rank field records the dictionary insertion order of chunks as subqueries and BM25 populate candidate_map. It is NOT a relevance ranking. Retrieval performance must be evaluated using dense subquery ranks, BM25 ranks, and Cross-Encoder ranks.

bm25_semantics.audit_finding: The recorded bm25_score value (N - r + 1) is a linear rank-based proxy derived from rank r, not an actual Okapi BM25 score.

C15.N20_N75: Stage 1 — Candidate Generation Failure (absent from pool)
C15.N100: Stage 2 — Reranking Failure (present at insertion pos #127, subquery 2 rank #97, but CE rank #79)

C42.N20_N50: Stage 1 — Candidate Generation Failure (absent from pool)
C42.N75_N100: Stage 2 — Reranking Failure (present at insertion pos #71, subquery 1 rank #71, but CE rank #45-#46)

ambiguities_resolved.Ambiguity_A_C15: C15 does NOT enter at N=50. Raw JSON artifact confirms C15 is ABSENT at N=20, 30, 50, 75 and FIRST ENTERS at N=100 (insertion pos #127, subquery 2 rank #97, CE score -4.9510, CE rank #79). It NEVER enters final Top-15.
ambiguities_resolved.Ambiguity_B_C42: C42 does NOT enter at N=30. Raw JSON artifact confirms C42 is ABSENT at N=20, 30, 50 and FIRST ENTERS at N=75 (insertion pos #71, subquery 1 rank #71, CE score +0.5802, CE rank #45). At N=100, CE rank is #46. It NEVER enters final Top-15.
ambiguities_resolved.Ambiguity_C_CandidateRecall: Candidate Recall sequence across N=20..100 is: 85.0% -> 90.0% -> 90.0% -> 95.0% -> 100.0%. Maximum candidate recall is 100.0% (at N=100), not 95.0%.
ambiguities_resolved.Ambiguity_D_FinalRecall: Final Recall@15 sequence across N=20..100 is: 70.0% -> 65.0% -> 60.0% -> 60.0% -> 60.0%. Final recall DEGRADES from 70.0% to 60.0% as N increases.
ambiguities_resolved.Ambiguity_E_ControlReproduction: Phase 11C control (N=20) reproduces canonical Phase 10C control with 100% exact match across all four metrics: Candidate Recall@20 = 85.0%, Final Recall@15 = 70.0%, nDCG@10 = 0.485, MRR = 0.369.

final_conclusion.central_question_answer: In the actual Phase 10C production retrieval pipeline, C15 and C42 are lost at shallow depth due to Candidate Generation Failure (N < 75/100). When candidate depth is increased (N=75 for C42, N=100 for C15), both targets enter the candidate pool but are rejected downstream by Cross-Encoder R0 (CE Rank #45/#79), classifying their ultimate bottleneck as RERANKING_FAILURE. Furthermore, deepening candidate depth degrades aggregate Final Recall@15 from 70.0% to 60.0% due to cross-encoder distractor noise.
final_conclusion.recommended_direction: Fix downstream Cross-Encoder reranker or candidate text representation rather than increasing candidate generation depth N.
